author_reading_scope: Inspected the complete relevant reasoning in the full 29-page Brown CS-96-08 PDF: §§3.1–3.4 for the POMDP model, Bayesian update, and belief-MDP interface, and §§4.1–4.3 for policy trees, state-conditional values, finite-horizon envelopes, backup, and pruning context. The local theorem proofs rederive the update, sufficiency, alpha-vector induction, convexity, and pruning invariance; no source citation substitutes for these proofs. Brown uses an action-dependent observation model, while this design specializes it to the plan’s action-independent O(o|s′). Inspected the complete relevant MIT Underactuated course-note page, lines 13–24, and all 19 Waterloo CS 886 lecture slides, especially slides 3–8, 9–15, and 19; the slides state results but do not replace local proofs. At current carriers, inspected the finite-MDP Definition and Verification, probability-kernel definition, full kernel-integration proof, generic AC-based conditional-probability definition, full dominated-kernel Bayes proof and conditional-density supplier, finite-sum definition/laws/double-sum proof, finite maximum proof, and cardinality/product/function-set/natural-power/induction suppliers. For the added clock-cardinality lemma, also read the complete current `lem-nat-order-is-membership` and `lem-nat-transitive-irreflexive` proofs; their exact claims support I_n=n and the capped successor induction. The explicit positive-history ratio defines finite conditional laws directly, so the generic conditional-probability AE-class and its AC assumption are deliberately unused. No source was dropped and no retrieval-failure source-resolution alternative proof is required. Additionally inspected Bob Dumas and John E. McCarthy, Transition to Higher Mathematics, §1.2, complete relevant page lines 205–242 and 244–262. Its lines 226–232 state that the segment of naturals below n is a canonical set with exactly n elements; the local lemma supplies a proof from the current library order-membership and cardinality statements, rather than treating that notation as its proof.

author_read_locators.disposition: The local model uses the action-independent observation specialization specified by the controlling plan. The paper's Bayes quotient is used only when its normalizer is positive. Its optimized witness LP and polynomial-time accounting are out of scope; complete finite-tree and safe-pruning arguments are local.

author_read_locators.locator: Complete relevant page inspected, lines 205–242 and 244–262. Lines 226–232 identify the set of natural numbers less than n as a canonical set with exactly n elements; lines 244–262 explain set extensionality. The local proof derives I_n=n from the library’s additive-order/membership theorem and derives |I_n|=n from its finite-cardinality definition.
